newsitem.title: USA: Photran reports 1996 loss, restated qtrly results.
newsitem.headline: Photran reports 1996 loss, restated qtrly results.

text.p: Photran Corp on Monday reported a net loss of $5.28 million for 1996, which as expected, included restated results for the first, second and third quarters of 1996.
As anticipated, Photran reported a net loss for the fourth quarter of 1996 of $4.27 million.
Photran had said in March that it might restate interim results for 1996 upon the conclusion of an investigation of certain financial and accounting irregularities.

Photran said it has been advised that the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has begun a formal investigation of the financial and accounting irregularies. It said it has not received notice of the scope of the investigation.

The company said it has finished its internal investigation and does not expect further adjustments to 1996 interim results. Photran said it found no evidence that any funds are missing and will cooperate fully with the SEC's inquiry.
Photran said its net sales for 1996 were $2.89 million, a 15 percent drop from 1995 revenues.

Photran said the drop in its revenues was due to a general market price decline from the TN ITO-coated glass that Photran makes and also a decision by a major customer to move to smaller sheets of glass.

Photran said it expects market prices to begin to recover in the second half of 1997, is pursuing the sale of larger sheets of glass to increase per-unit revenue, and is taking aggressive steps to reduce costs and enhance productivity.
The company said its fourth quarter loss reflected writedowns of projects that it is canceling to better focus its operations. Sales for the quarter were $665,349.
Photran said it has halted work on, and is reviewing plans for, its Zero-Ray anti-glare filters for computer screens and televisions.
Photran said it is re-evaluating its research and development activities and plans to focus on products that build upon its core thin-film glass-coating technologies.
The fourth quarter results include equipment writeoffs of $1.8 million related to a canceled Chinese joint venture and an additional $386,000 of writeoffs related to Zero-Ray.
For the first quarter, Photran said it reduced revenue by $460,491 to reverse sales transactions. Net income was reduced from $79,029 to a net loss of $217,396, or $0.07 a share.

For the second quarter, restated results reduced revenues from $1.65 million to $785,648. The company posted a restated net loss for the quarter of $423,655 or $0.11 a share, compared with net income of $127,143.
For the third quarter, net sales were reduced from $2.07 million to $758,085, and net income was reduced from $184,929 to a net loss of $366,916, or $0.07 a share.
